title: Genesis 2:8-9: the garden in Eden, tree of life, tree of knowledge
summary: Genesis 2:8-9 in English with the Hebrew reference: the LORD God plants a garden in Eden and puts the man there, and makes every pleasing tree grow, including the tree of life and the tree of the knowledge of good and evil. The words LORD God are in multicoloured letters, and tree, life, knowledge, good and evil stand out in colour or larger type.

text.text: 8 The LORD God planted a garden toward the east, in Eden; and there He placed the man whom He had formed.

9 Out of the ground the LORD God caused to grow every tree that is pleasing to the sight and good for food; the tree of life also in the midst of the garden, and the tree of the knowledge of good and evil.
